### Connected by kindness

The Avery Dennison Foundation focuses on creating impact where it’s needed most. Through
grantmaking, we support a more thriving world. Watch our new video, illustrating how we foster a
more diverse and sustainable global community.

[Read more][157]

### Ready for what’s next. ReadyDPP™.

ReadyDPP is Avery Dennison’s integrated, full service solution that seamlessly creates and manages
Digital Product Passports. We reduce the complexity of compliance, giving you total control and
peace of mind to focus on whatever’s next for your brand.

[Learn more][158]

### Anti-dew protective overlay

Dew can cut sign reflectivity by 60% at night, risking safety. Avery Dennison OL-1200 clear overlay
film prevents dew droplets from forming, maintaining optimal visibility and sign reliability.

[Learn more][159]

# Nano-Clear Industrial Coatings

**Painted Assets + Nano-Clear = 15+ Year Performance**

**Dramatically extend the surface life of your fleet, military, and industrial painted assets with
Nano-Clear® Coatings**.

 

Nano-Clear NC 40 Coating reduces repaint cycles by 2X-3X and extends the surface life of painted
assets by 15+ years. Engineered to dramatically improve corrosion, scratch, abrasion, chemical &
long-term UV resistance. Designed as a clear overcoat, Nano-Clear NC 40 applies directly over epoxy,
polyurethane and powder coating systems, making integration simple and effective.

 

**Built for harsh environments - where failure is not an option.**

# Advanced Water & Stain Repellent Protection

Explore our innovative superhydrophobic coatings that provide unparalleled protection against
various liquids, enhancing durability across a wide range of applications.

[Learn More][3]

## What NeverWet Protects Matters - Without Changing How it Looks or Feels


## NeverWet Commercial, Industrial, & OEM Use

NeverWet has designed numerous industrial products for business, commercial and OEM use. Industrial
grade NeverWet products can vary based upon the substrate where it is being applied and are offered
in large quantities from 5-gallon pails to 55-gallon drums.

[See it in Action][4]
[Hiker On Mountain]

## Footwear & Sports Apparel

NEVERWET Fluorine Free Post Production Applied Fabric OEM DWR is a superhydrophobic,
post-production, multi-liquid and stain resistant treatment designed to keep textiles dry and clean.
This crystal clear formula allows fabrics to breathe, while dramatically repelling water from the
surface.


Features & Benefits
*  Protects textiles from water and stains - crystal clear formula will not change the look, feel or
  breathability of the fabric or other material.
*  Ideal for use on polyester, nylon, suede, canvas and other synthetics.
*  Ideal for footwear, outdoor furniture, gloves, outdoor apparel and more.
*  Easy-to-use, one-step application is able to cover up to 375 sq.ft./gallon.
*  Prob 65, REACH, CPSIA and RoHS Compliant.
*  Available in 5 gallon pails.
*  SVHC's not present.

## Apparel & Upholstery

NEVERWET Fluorine Free High Performance Fabric Mill Applied DWR is a one-step, superhydrophobic,
multi-liquid, stain resistant treatement designed to keep textiles dry. This crystal clear formula
allows fabrics to breathe, while repelling multiple liquids and stains from the surface.


Features & Benefits
*  Protects textiles from multi-liquids and water borne stains - crystal clear formula will not
  change the look, feel or breathability of the fabric or other materials.
*  Ideal for use on polyester, nylon, poly/cotton blends, canvas and other synthetics. Maintains
  performance for up to 40 home wash and cycles.
*  Ideal for textile mill applications - incorporate at a 20:1 ratio in a mill bath with ph of
  5-5.5.
*  Can cover-up to 1,000 linear yards/gallon.
*  Cures in heat tunnel at 300°F(149°C) for 5 minutes or 370°F(189°C) for 1 minute.
*  Prop. 65, REACH, CPSIA and RoHS Compliant.
*  Available in 5 gallon pails or 55 gallon drums.
*  SVHC's not present.

[Contemporary Living Room]
[plate self cleaning 1 Tess Cunningham]

## Multi-Surface Industrial

NEVERWET Multi-Surface Industrial is a superhydrophobic treatment that dramatically repels water,
mud, ice and other liquids. This revolutionary new class of coatings cause water to form nearly
perfect spheres which roll off the surface keeping items dry and clean. NeverWet is a two part
treatment consisting of a base coat and top coat that work best on wood, metal, concrete and
masonry. The treatment dries to a flat milky haze.
* Causes liquids to form nearly perfect spheres, which roll off of the surface keeping it dry and
  clean
* VOC compliant nationwide
* 2-Step Coating System: After base coat is applied, wait 45 minutes and apply top coat. NeverWet
  will repel water after 30 minutes. Wait 12 hours for optimal performance.
* Product is spray applied via air atomized sprayers. Brush or roll-on application is not suitable
  for this product.
* Product highlights: anti-wetting, anti-corrosion, anti-icing, anti-contamination, self-cleaning. 


[nwt_logo_waterrepellingtreatments_wo_rustoleum tess cunningham.jpg]

Industrial-Grade Surface Protection.
All rights reserved.

# ABOUT SABIC

From making cars and planes more fuel-efficient, to helping conserve the world’s water supply and
enabling colorful smartphone cases, we find solutions to the challenges of today to help our
customers achieve their ambitions and build a better tomorrow.

## Our Industries

[OUR INDUSTRIES][177]

[A man holding looking at a tablet screen with a chart]

## Products

We gain insights by understanding our customers’ needs and use our technical expertise to tailor
solutions to help maximize their market advantage moving forward.

[OUR PRODUCTS][178]

## Sustainability

Sustainability is a vital part of our core business strategy. We're making sure we understand the
megatrends that will impact on our lives in the years to come.

[LATEST SUSTAINABILITY REPORTING][179]
[Two]

## Investors

We’re committed to long-term investments and business partnerships, by harnessing innovation,
learning and operational excellence.

[INVESTORS][180]

## CAREERS

People have helped us to develop, produce and market innovative solutions that make a difference
both to industry and to humanity. At SABIC we enable you to realize your ideas and make an impact.

[VIEW JOB OPPORTUNITIES][181]
[Three people looking at a whiteboard]
[
][182]

## Our Brand

We believe the answer to some of the world's biggest challenges lies in the natural human instinct
to collaborate. Together we're making Chemistry that Matters™.

[Our Brand][183]

## Our Stories

For over 45 years, our ambition to define the future of petrochemicals has yielded solutions for the
challenges of today and helped our customers achieve their ambitions for a better tomorrow. We are
making a meaningful impact in the world and delivering Chemistry that Matters™.

[Read our stories][184]

# ABOUT SABIC

From making cars and planes more fuel-efficient, to helping conserve the world’s water supply and
enabling colorful smartphone cases, we find solutions to the challenges of today to help our
customers achieve their ambitions and build a better tomorrow.

## Products

We gain insights by understanding our customers’ needs and use our technical expertise to tailor
solutions to help maximize their market advantage moving forward.

[OUR PRODUCTS][178]

## Sustainability

Sustainability is a vital part of our core business strategy. We're making sure we understand the
megatrends that will impact on our lives in the years to come.

[LATEST SUSTAINABILITY REPORTING][179]
[Two]

## Investors

We’re committed to long-term investments and business partnerships, by harnessing innovation,
learning and operational excellence.

[INVESTORS][180]

## CAREERS

People have helped us to develop, produce and market innovative solutions that make a difference
both to industry and to humanity. At SABIC we enable you to realize your ideas and make an impact.

[VIEW JOB OPPORTUNITIES][181]
[Three people looking at a whiteboard]
[
][182]

## Our Brand

We believe the answer to some of the world's biggest challenges lies in the natural human instinct
to collaborate. Together we're making Chemistry that Matters™.

[Our Brand][183]

## Our Stories

For over 45 years, our ambition to define the future of petrochemicals has yielded solutions for the
challenges of today and helped our customers achieve their ambitions for a better tomorrow. We are
making a meaningful impact in the world and delivering Chemistry that Matters™.

[Read our stories][184]

The use of D.I.M.S technology reduces paracentral defocus, not only correcting sharp central vision,
but also presenting peripheral visual images clearly in front of the peripheral retina, i.e.
achieving peripheral myopia out-of-focus, which serves to slow down the growth of the eye axis
without affecting normal visual outcomes and alleviating the deepening of myopia.

## **Myopia Control Spectacle Lenses in Children**

The use of D.I.M.S technology reduces paracentral defocus, not only correcting sharp central vision,
but also presenting peripheral visual images clearly in front of the peripheral retina, i.e.
achieving peripheral myopia out-of-focus, which serves to slow down the growth of the eye axis
without affecting normal visual outcomes and alleviating the deepening of myopia.

* Swift and convenient

* Best ForDaily screen use, office work, study, and prolonged digital device exposure

## The Ultimate In Automotive Protection & Enhancement...

*We are a leading, UK based automotive surface protection, detailing and customisation specialist,
offering a range of products and services designed to protect and enhance your car, your motorcycle
and your most valued possessions.*

Although quite varied, our services are tailored towards a common goal – to improve your ownership
experience and retain long-term value in your investment.

To achieve this, we implement a four stage process…
1. ### Listen
   
   to our customer to ensure that we completely understand their requirements
2. ### Plan
   
   our strategy to ensure that we can achieve the objective within an agreed budget and timescale
3. ### Process
   
   an order or carry out workmanship to the highest possible standard using only the finest
   materials
4. ### Deliver
   
   on time and in a fashion that will either meet or exceed the customers' expectations

## CCM Spitfire Cafe Racer

It was a real privilege for us to work on this stunning CCM Spitfire Cafe Racer on behalf of one of
our regular clients. The motorcycle enjoyed a thorough de-contamination and detail followed by the
application of our full self-healing PPF kit and NanoTech protective coatings. This exclusive
‘fusion’ package has been designed to protect every surface of the motorcycle including the
paintwork, wheels, leather, engine and mechanical components, thus giving this beautiful machine the
very best start in life. An absolute joy to work on… not to mention the aural pleasure derived from
the underslung exhaust!

producing custom motorcycle accessories… the old adage ‘there aren’t enough hours in the day’ could
easily be our new slogan!
